agreement-body: Use the game’s own voice or text and nothing else. Half of these puzzles are built out of walls you cannot talk through and distances you cannot shout across — an outside call on the side deletes them, and you will not even notice it happening.
agreement-room: If two of you are in the same room, use headphones and separate rooms if you can. The island cannot muffle a person sitting next to you.
booth-status: {{n}} entered. Wrong one and it starts again.
bucket-on: You have a bucket on your head
click-hint: WASD to walk · Shift to run · C to sit · E to pick up · F to throw · V to talk · Enter to type · M for the map · Esc to stop
code-hint: The host has this on screen. They need to be online for it to work.
code-note: Anyone with this can walk in while you are online. Close the session and everybody goes home — the island keeps its progress.
ending-after: The island is still there. Anything you left unfinished is still unfinished, the cart still runs, and the hoop does not care that you have nothing left to prove.
ending-body: Nobody explains the gate, or the towers, or why any of it wanted red things. That was never the part you were going to find out.
ending-tally: What the island has of yours
final-read: Read it. Somebody is in the booth.
final-stand: Stand on them. All of you, together.
final-turn: Turn them. Somebody is on the lookout.
finder-hint: To the nearest one. It will not tell you which way.
gestures-note: None of these mean anything yet. Decide what they mean and then be consistent about it.
guest-note: The host owns this campaign and has to be online for it to continue. Everything you do out there is saved to their island.
highlight: Mark things you can pick up
hunt-status: {{n}} of {{total}} dug up. Somebody needs the finder.
lock-crew: There are more places to stand than there are of you.
lock-key: Nothing here responds yet. A tower has not been fed.
map-alt: A hand-drawn map of the island
map-footer: It does not show where you are. Work that out from what you can see, and say it out loud.
mic-off-note: You will still hear everyone who speaks.
mic-on-note: Hold V to talk. You can change that in settings once you are out there.
need-two: Nothing on the island can be solved alone. Wait for at least one more before walking off.
no-map-body: Somebody left one at the landing and there is another at the north halt. Until one of you is carrying it, you navigate by looking at things.
no-saves: Nothing yet. A campaign appears here once you have started or joined one.
pack-none: Nobody has given you a backpack.
pack-sealed: It is on your back. Somebody else has to walk over and get things out of it.
pads-status: {{held}} of {{total}} pads have somebody on them.
paused-note: The island does not pause. Everyone else is still out there and the sun is still moving.
reveal-booth: Painted on the wall in here. The console is outside.
reveal-booth-half: Your half of the sequence. The other booth has the marks that go between yours.
reveal-plate-hint: It is lit for you and not for them. Say which way to walk from where they are, not from where you are.
reveal-totems: Painted on the hillside, in order left to right as you look at them from here.
save-line: {{solved}} of {{sites}} done · {{orbs}} of {{total}} given · hosted by {{host}}
signin-body: A campaign is a save, and a save belongs to an account — so you need to be signed in before you can start one or walk somebody else’s.
skip-hint: Some challenges specifically need hearing, speaking, quick reactions or precise aim. Turning this on lets the host step past one without ending the campaign.
skip-hint-lobby: You can change this at any time. A skipped challenge still produces its red rounds.
stable-frame-hint: Paints a fixed border and centre mark that do not move with the camera. Helps a lot if first-person motion gets to you.
tagline: Two to twelve friends, one handcrafted island, and no way to solve anything without telling somebody what you can see.
text-only: Text only — never open my microphone
text-only-hint: Typed messages travel exactly as far as speech does, fade the same way, and are blocked by the same walls. You can finish the whole campaign this way.
text-only-restart: Takes effect the next time you walk out from the landing.
title: Massive March
variant-crew_one: 퍼즐은 한 번에 {{count}}명을 위해 밝게 빛납니다.
variant-crew_other: Puzzles will light up for {{count}} people at a time.
variant-hint: Pick the smallest number that will actually turn up. More people can always join a smaller world; fewer people cannot finish a bigger one.
